result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same landscape code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli compile`). I didn't run any tests or the command itself, so I haven't confirmed that `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` creates `config.json` and `index.html`.

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` next to `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run()` sends both names to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method. Its `-help` branch prints the usage for whichever name you typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It lists `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape`, `updateLandscape` (same command, kept for existing scripts) and `updateConfig`.

I didn't commit.
